name: Moonraker-Klipper
author: airbornetrooper82573
description: Cycle through Klipper printers with live Moonraker thumbnails on wide RGB LED matrices.

versions.notes: Preview now reads unsaved settings from LEDMatrix data-setting-key fields and detects physical dimensions from /api/v3/config/main.
Fix custom color widget to follow LEDMatrix field-ID getValue/setValue contract, emit widget-change and update live preview.
Fix color picker key detection and immediate preview synchronization for unsaved settings.
Rename plugin to Moonraker-Klipper and expand preview to reflect settings, enabled printers, status filters, thumbnail toggle and display timing.
Add native color picker widgets and live 320x32 printer preview within the LEDMatrix settings.
Configurable font sizes and colors, plus Moonraker pre-print activity messages replacing progress bar.
Smaller pixel-art nozzle and heated-bed icons and temperature typography.
Replace E/B temperature labels with pixel-art icons.
Initial multi-printer rotation and thumbnail support.

widgets.name: moonraker-color-picker
widgets.description: Native browser color picker for display elements
